title: Geometric faithfulness of odd abelian level on a curve
statement: Let $\Omega$ be an algebraically closed field [def-weil-field, def-weil-algebraic-closure], and let $C$ be a smooth projective connected curve over $\Omega$ of genus $g\geq2$ [def-sc-curves, def-sc-genus, def-kun-projective]. Let $\ell\geq3$ be a prime different from $\operatorname{char}(\Omega)$. If a $\Omega$-automorphism $u:C\xrightarrow{\sim}C$ acts as the identity on $H^1(C_{\mathrm{et}},\mathbf Z/\ell\mathbf Z)$, then $u=\mathrm{id}_C$. Cohomology is [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology] of the constant sheaf [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf].

source.place: Section 1.1(1) (g >= 2) and Section 2.3.3, geometric rigidity implicit in the fine abelian-level assertion for m >= 3. This node isolates only the geometric stabilizer assertion, not scheme representability. Local PDF WANTED; primary author PDF read online.

proof.text: Choose a primitive $\ell$-th root $\zeta\in\Omega$ by [lem-sc-primitive-root]. The associated sheaf isomorphism $\theta_\zeta:(\mathbf Z/\ell\mathbf Z)_C\simeq\mu_{\ell,C}$ is [def-sc-mu-trivialization]. Since $u$ is an $\Omega$-morphism, it fixes the scalar $\zeta$, so pullback sends $\zeta^a$ to $\zeta^a$. Thus $\theta_\zeta$ commutes with $u$ and the coefficient comparison. Naturality of cohomological pullback [lem-weil-pbc-cohomology-pullback-functorial](3) gives $H^1(\theta_\zeta)u^*=u^*H^1(\theta_\zeta)$. The hypothesis and invertibility of $H^1(\theta_\zeta)$ therefore show that $u^*$ is the identity on $H^1(C_{\mathrm{et}},\mu_\ell)$.

source.place: §14, Remark 14.4, printed p.92; coefficient trivialization and pullback naturality

proof.text: The curve $C$ is proper by [lem-kun-projective-implies-proper]. By [lem-sc-global-functions], $\mathcal O_C(C)=\Omega$; hence its units are $\ell$-divisible, since every nonzero scalar has an $\ell$-th root in the algebraically closed field. Also [lem-sc-brauer-zero] applies to this smooth separated connected curve. The degree-one assertion of [lem-sc-kummer-les] now identifies $H^1(C_{\mathrm{et}},\mu_\ell)$ with $\operatorname{Pic}(C)[\ell]$, through the map induced by $i:\mu_\ell\hookrightarrow\mathbf G_m$. Under cohomological pullback, the units comparison restricts to the roots-of-unity comparison: $u^*(z^\ell)=(u^*z)^\ell$. Naturality [lem-weil-pbc-cohomology-pullback-functorial](3), applied to $i$, makes its map on $H^1$ commute with $u^*$. By [lem-sc-h1-gm-pic-pullback] the resulting action on $\operatorname{Pic}(C)$ is $[L]\mapsto[u^*L]$. Consequently every class of $\operatorname{Pic}(C)[\ell]$ is fixed: write it as the image of $b\in H^1(C,\mu_\ell)$ and use $u^*b=b$ from step 1.

source.place: §14, Proposition 14.1 and proof of Theorem 14.2, printed pp.89–91; functoriality of the Kummer inclusion

proof.text: Choose the representing Jacobian $J=\operatorname{Pic}^0_{C/\Omega}$ by [sk-thm-picard-main], which applies to our smooth proper connected curve. Equip it with $\lambda_C$ and let $a_u$ be the pullback automorphism from [lem-sfb-curve-polarized-jacobian-faithfulness]. This is an automorphism of the group variety, with no choice of a base point on $C$. The equality $J[\ell](\Omega)=\operatorname{Pic}(C)[\ell]$ in [det-cor-jacobian-torsion-pic](2) identifies its action there with $[L]\mapsto[u^*L]$. Step 2 therefore proves $a_u(x)=x$ for every $x\in J[\ell](\Omega)$, and the same Jacobian-faithfulness node states $a_u^\vee\lambda_Ca_u=\lambda_C$.

source.place: III §§1 and 6, canonical Picard variety and polarization; compare LEC §14, Proposition 14.1

proof.text: Apply [lem-sfb-polarized-abelian-odd-level-rigidity] with $k=\Omega$, $A=J$, $\lambda=\lambda_C$, $a=a_u$, and $n=\ell$. The group-automorphism, polarization-preservation and torsion-fixing hypotheses were checked in step 3. The integer $\ell$ is invertible in $\Omega$ by the characteristic hypothesis and is at least $3$. The lemma gives $a_u=\mathrm{id}_J$.

By the injectivity clause of [lem-sfb-curve-polarized-jacobian-faithfulness], $a_u=\mathrm{id}_J$ forces $u=\mathrm{id}_C$. The genus hypothesis is used here: the lemma assumes $g\geq2$, as in our statement.

proof_origin.place: Assembly of I Proposition 14.4(b), III §6 and Theorem 12.1(b), with LEC §14 Kummer theory. This supplies an explicit geometric proof of the stabilizer assertion implicit in Pikaart–de Jong §2.3.3.

reviewed.note: mechanical checks by tools/merge_delivery.py; mathematics reviewed in full by NT-cc-NH-9b0bbb8c5 (reviewer sub-agent of L); spot-checked: Read the item, all five steps and both new statement-only nodes in full. The item statement, stmt_deps and source are unchanged from base (compared with the Q22 snapshots). There is no re-split note and no SGA citation. Step 1: theta_zeta from lem-sc-primitive-root and def-sc-mu-trivialization commutes with the pullback comparison for an Omega-automorphism; naturality clause (3) of lem-weil-pbc-cohomology-pullback-functorial (checked verbatim) moves the trivial action to H^1(mu_ell). Step 2: the curve is proper (lem-kun-projective-implies-proper), O(C)=Omega (lem-sc-global-functions, last sentence), Br=0 (lem-sc-brauer-zero), so H^1(mu_ell)=Pic[ell] by lem-sc-kummer-les via H^1(i); naturality applied to i and lem-sc-h1-gm-pic-pullback give u^*L ~ L on Pic[ell]. Step 3: sk-thm-picard-main and det-cor-jacobian-torsion-pic(2) give J[ell](Omega)=Pic(C)[ell]. Steps 4 and 5 check every hypothesis of the two new nodes. New nodes: the rigidity node is Milne AV I Prop 14.4(b), read at p.62/63; n invertible is correctly kept because the proof uses the group scheme A_n, and n>=3 is needed ([-1] fixes A[2]). The Jacobian node: Milne III s6 theta polarization, which is preserved since u^* maps W_{g-1} to a translate of Theta; injectivity follows from III Thm 12.1(b) with beta=id, P=P' and sign + fixed, which covers the hyperelliptic case and all characteristics; g>=2 is needed. Both new nodes are true, neither restates the item, and rg -L and blueprint searches found no duplicates. Batch-5: I recomputed the target closure with and without the item's proof. The 25 added nodes are only Picard-framework nodes, sk-def-av-group-scheme and sk-def-av-mult-n, plus the item and its new nodes. The flagged lem-trf-curve-euler-tensor-generic-rank, lem-trf-proper-finite-fibre-finite-near and def-pod-ring-scalar-extension are already in the closure. sk-thm-picard-main, det-cor-jacobian-torsion-pic, def-sc-jacobian, lem-sc-brauer-zero and lem-sc-kummer-les are general Picard and Kummer facts or definitions, not statements or proof steps of the trace formula or Poincare duality, so they are accepted. The cross-chapter generic tool_uses are accepted.
